title: Length validation in edhoc_kdf happens after CBOR encoding
description:
File: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/kdf.rs
Lines: 47, 76-93

The length parameter is validated at three separate points:
1. Lines 76-88: CBOR encoding accepts length up to 0xffff
2. Line 92-93: okm.resize fails if length > 128 (buffer capacity)
3. Line 94-95: HKDF-Expand fails if length > 255*32

The CBOR encoding work is wasted if length > 128.

Fix: Add early validation at function entry:
```rust
if length > 128 {
    return Err(EdhocError::BufferTooSmall);
}
```
